class.name: OcgXscontrolWorksession
class.brief_description: This WorkSession completes the basic one, by adding : - use of Controller, with norm selection... - management of transfers (both ways) with auxiliary classes TransferReader and TransferWriter -> these transfers may work with a Context List : its items are given by the user, according to the transfer to be i.e. it is interpreted by the Actors Each item is accessed by a Name
class.description: ! This WorkSession completes the basic one, by adding : ! - use of Controller, with norm selection... ! - management of transfers (both ways) with auxiliary classes ! TransferReader and TransferWriter ! -> these transfers may work with a Context List : its items ! are given by the user, according to the transfer to be ! i.e. it is interpreted by the Actors ! Each item is accessed by a Name

method.name: ClearData
method.description: In addition to basic ClearData, clears Transfer and Management for interactive use, for mode = 0,1,2 and over 4 Plus : mode = 5 to clear Transfers (both ways) only mode = 6 to clear enforced results mode = 7 to clear transfers, results

method.name: SelectNorm
method.description: Selects a Norm defined by its name. A Norm is described and handled by a Controller Returns True if done, False if <normname> is unknown

method.name: SetController
method.description: Selects a Norm defined by its Controller itself

method.name: SelectedNorm
method.description: Returns the name of the last Selected Norm. If none is defined, returns an empty string By default, returns the complete name of the norm If <rsc> is True, returns the short name used for resource

method.name: NormAdaptor
method.description: Returns the norm controller itself

method.name: Context
method.description: Returns the current Context List, Null if not defined The Context is given to the TransientProcess for TransferRead

method.name: SetAllContext
method.description: Sets the current Context List, as a whole Sets it to the TransferReader

method.name: ClearContext
method.description: Clears the whole current Context (nullifies it)

method.name: PrintTransferStatus
method.description: Prints the transfer status of a transferred item, as being the Mapped n0 <num>, from MapWriter if <wri> is True, or from MapReader if <wri> is False Returns True when done, False else (i.e. num out of range)

method.name: InitTransferReader
method.description: Sets a Transfer Reader, by internal ways, according mode : 0 recreates it clear, 1 clears it (does not recreate) 2 aligns Roots of TransientProcess from final Results 3 aligns final Results from Roots of TransientProcess 4 begins a new transfer (by BeginTransfer) 5 recreates TransferReader then begins a new transfer

method.name: SetTransferReader
method.description: Sets a Transfer Reader, which manages transfers on reading

method.name: TransferReader
method.description: Returns the Transfer Reader, Null if not set

method.name: MapReader
method.description: Returns the TransientProcess(internal data for TransferReader)

method.name: SetMapReader
method.description: Changes the Map Reader, i.e. considers that the new one defines the relevant read results (forgets the former ones) Returns True when done, False in case of bad definition, i.e. if Model from TP differs from that of Session

method.name: Result
method.description: Returns the result attached to a starting entity If <mode> = 0, returns Final Result If <mode> = 1, considers Last Result If <mode> = 2, considers Final, else if absent, Last returns it as Transient, if result is not transient returns the Binder <mode> = 10,11,12 idem but returns the Binder itself (if it is not, e.g. Shape, returns the Binder) <mode> = 20, returns the ResultFromModel

method.name: TransferReadOne
method.description: Commands the transfer of, either one entity, or a list I.E. calls the TransferReader after having analysed <ents> It is cumulated from the last BeginTransfer <ents> is processed by GiveList, hence : - <ents> a Selection : its SelectionResult - <ents> a HSequenceOfTransient : this list - <ents> the Model : in this specific case, all the roots, with no cumulation of former transfers (TransferReadRoots)

method.name: TransferReadRoots
method.description: Commands the transfer of all the root entities of the model i.e. calls TransferRoot from the TransferReader with the Graph No cumulation with former calls to TransferReadOne

method.name: NewModel
method.description: produces and returns a new Model well conditioned It is produced by the Norm Controller It can be Null (if this function is not implemented)

method.name: TransferWriter
method.description: Returns the Transfer Reader, Null if not set

method.name: SetMapWriter
method.description: Changes the Map Reader, i.e. considers that the new one defines the relevant read results (forgets the former ones) Returns True when done, False if <FP> is Null

method.name: TransferWriteShape
method.description: Transfers a Shape from CasCade to a model of current norm, according to the last call to SetModeWriteShape Returns status :Done if OK, Fail if error during transfer, Error if transfer badly initialised

method.name: TransferWriteCheckList
method.description: Returns the check-list of last transfer (write) It is recorded in the FinderProcess, but it must be bound with resulting entities (in the resulting file model) rather than with original objects (in fact, their mappers)
